propositions: Rotation timestamps must be migrated from inline legacy fields in bindings.json to a new sidecar file .bridge_state/get_rotation.json
New binaries must write rotation state to both the sidecar and legacy inline field while reading max(sidecar, legacy) to ensure compatibility across mixed old/new binary versions
The reconcile-check command must not create the get_rotation.json sidecar when persist=False is set
All persisted saves—end-of-pass, write-ahead saves in dispatch_one.py, and recovery saves in binding_store.py—must write the sidecar atomically through BindingStore.save()
The new get_rotation.py module must remain cohesive and under size constraints to avoid violating the 800-line locked policy on binding_store.py and outbound_differ.py
The git staging path and basename membership checks must explicitly include GET_ROTATION_FILE so local reconciliation commits the sidecar without git add -A
